findings.text: follow-on: the sentence "so the eligibility gate was live and its exclusions differed row from row" is not supported by the JSON it cites. On all 20 rows the excluded set is identical -- claude, claude-haiku, claude-opus, clive and native, each with reason "availability: unavailable" -- and the offered set is identical too (codex, codex-astra, codex-luna, codex-terra). What varies row to row is the picker's pick (codex 11, codex-astra 6, codex-terra 3) and the per-candidate detail fields (clive congestion running 10..15, clive outcomes, worker_slots 1..3), not the exclusions. The section's conclusion (the eligibility gate was live) stands on the presence of 4 offered and 5 excluded candidates on every row; the "differed row from row" clause should be dropped or replaced by the varying pick distribution and confidence range (0.19..0.65).
